items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 44:1
items.html: It is the gematria of the filling of HaVaYaH of AB. And it is the phase of the coarseness fit to bring out upon it the level of Hochma. (Page 1019, Item 21).
